title: Coverage Under Contradiction: A Benchmark for Negation-Aware Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.37162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). translated_title: 矛盾下的覆盖性评估：一个否定感知检索的基准
translated_abstract: 覆盖性评估基准用于量化检索到的证据是否覆盖了满足信息需求所需的各种信息片段。现有基准大多只考虑预训练检索组件可能已经掌握的事实性陈述，因此尚未解决一个开放性问题：当语料库证据与这些先验知识相矛盾时，检索器能否找到证据。我们研究了当检索器的参数化知识与语料库中的信息不一致时，检索器的行为表现。为此，我们开发了一种流程，通过受控的矛盾对基于信息点（nugget）的覆盖性基准进行增强。对于每个信息点，我们创建其否定版本，并编辑其支持文档使其支持该否定陈述，同时保留原有上下文。将该流程应用于衡量信息覆盖性的基准 CoverageBench，我们构建了 CoverageBench-Negate，涵盖六个数据集以及约 63,000 个“原始-编辑”证据对（每个信息点-文档链接对应一对）。我们还附带了丰富的构建元数据……
tldr: 该论文提出了 CoverageBench-Negate 基准，通过为每个信息点构建否定版本并相应编辑支持文档，首次系统性地研究了检索器在语料库证据与其参数化知识相矛盾时的行为表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CoverageBench-Negate, a benchmark built by creating negated nugget counterparts and editing supporting documents to inject controlled contradictions, enabling a systematic study of how retrievers behave when corpus evidence contradicts their parametric knowledge.
